Marissa — forwarding Heliotrix ask. They want an off-catalog SKU (private VPC + larger context) and are requesting a 30% first-year discount + waived setup. Deal notes: 4M tokens/mo pilot; projected $200k ARR post-POC.

Internal summary / decision needed:
- Commercial ask: 30% discount (token units) + waiver of private deployment setup fee for the 4-month POC; potential full-production commit of $200k ARR afterward.
- Operational impact: Requires Dedicated/Private deployment onboarding (security review) and a one-time engineering runbook for the custom SKU mapping.
- Risk: If we waive setup and give 30% now, unit economics degrade ~28% in year 1 vs. standard pricing (see attached quick calc).

Proposed internal options (select one):
A) Approve full ask (30% + waived setup) — escalation to VP/CFO required.
B) Approve limited concession: 20% discount + 50% setup fee waiver; require 12-month minimum commit at go-live.
C) Decline pricing concession; offer technical credits and fast-track onboarding instead.

Please review and confirm preferred option. If we approve option A or B, we need a formal exception memo for VP/CFO signoff (I drafted a short memo attached for review).

Attachment: redwood-exception-memo-draft.pdf

Markus — thanks for the note. Quick thoughts:
- Commercial: 30% is aggressive for a new account with no prior spend. If they can commit to the $200k ARR at production launch (within 6 months) we could justify a deeper first-year concession, but we need a hard milestone-driven clause.
- Finance will want a clear uplift path (step-down discounts after month 6) and a clawback if they don't hit the commit.
- I prefer Option B with a stronger production commitment: 20% pilot discount + 50% setup fee waiver, plus an option to escalate to 30% if they hit a $200k ARR threshold within 90 days of go-live.

Can @kimberly run a quick P&L impact? Also @karthik — can you confirm whether sales is willing to take regional quota hit for this pilot (we will need to carve for Q1).

Short timeline: we need VP/CFO approval for anything above 25% or that waives setup fees. If we go Option B, I can handle drafting the clause language for the SOW.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
VP, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Subject: Escalation memo for VP/CFO signoff — Heliotrix custom SKU pilot (decision required EOD 2026-11-30)

Team —

This is an internal escalation seeking a VP/CFO decision on the Heliotrix pricing exception. Procurement needs our formal position today to meet the customer's schedule. I have summarized the case below and attached the exception memo (pdf). Please review and respond with APPROVE / APPROVE W/ MOD / DECLINE before EOD.

Executive summary:
- Ask: One-time pilot concession: 30% discount on token units for the first 12 months and full waiver of private deployment setup fees for the 4-month POC.
- Customer: Heliotrix Therapeutics (new logo). Pilot estimated usage: 4M tokens/mo; assumed conversion to $200k ARR if successful.
- Recommended commercial path (my recommendation): Approve Option B with escalation clause (APPROVE W/ MOD): 20% pilot discount + 50% setup fee waiver; automatic review for a 30% top-up if Heliotrix meets $200k ARR within 90 days of production go-live. Include a clawback: retroactive charge if commit not met within 6 months.

Financial impact (year 1):
- Baseline revenue at standard rates (no concession): ~$340,000 ARR (projected if pilot converts).
- Option A (full 30% + waived setup): ~245,000 ARR (loss vs baseline ~$95k first-year delta).
- Option B (20% + 50% setup waiver): ~272,000 ARR (delta ~$68k).

Operational notes:
- Engineering will need a 3-week runbook to provision the private deployment; waiving the setup fee transfers that cost to Redwood.
- Security sign-off pending — customer has completed initial questionnaire but needs one additional SOC-light artifact.

Recommended approval language for VP/CFO (short):
"Approve a limited pricing exception for Heliotrix Therapeutics: 20% discount for the pilot period, 50% waiver of private deployment setup with requirement of a 12-month production commit at go-live and a 90-day $200k ARR attainment clause to unlock potential additional 10% discount. Include a clawback clause for non-performance within 6 months. Approval limited to one-time exception and no other concessions to be granted for 18 months"

Attachments: redwood-exception-memo-draft.pdf (detailed financials and legal language), heliotrix-MAP-proposed.xlsx (usage sheet)

Please reply with your vote and any edits. If I do not hear an objection, I will submit the formal exception memo to Finance for VP/CFO routing at 17:00 PST.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
